scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Halt right there!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
站住！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We have information
that you've been secretly
communicating with
Baba Yaga, the Horrible.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们得到情报，你一直在秘密地与可怕的芭芭雅嘎联络。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
If you have something to say,
speak to the Csar.
Come with us.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
如果你有话要说，就去跟沙皇说吧。
跟我们走。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We expected
that you would appear again.
What is your business with the Csar?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们早料到你会再次出现。
你找沙皇有什么事？

scripts.text: Run away.
scripts.translation: 逃跑

scripts.text: Explain the situation.
scripts.translation: 解释情况

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I should get out of here...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得赶紧离开这里...

scripts.text: -I explain what happend until now.-
scripts.translation: -我把到目前为止发生的事情解释了一遍。-

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
If you have something to say, speak
to the Csar.
If you leave to this place,
you will be considered as our enemy.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
如果你有话要说，就去跟沙皇说吧。
如果你离开这里，就会被视为我们的敌人。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We're the Csar's soldiers.
We're called out for emergencies,
don't disturb us anymore.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们是沙皇的士兵。
我们是被紧急召集来的，别再打扰我们了。

scripts.text: - There is writing on a big rock. -
scripts.translation: - 一块巨大的岩石上刻着文字。 -

scripts.text: ^3131FF- Those who serve the Sun will die, Go to the North. -^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF- 侍奉太阳者必死，向北而去。 -^000000

scripts.text: - There is writing on a big rock. -
scripts.translation: - 一块巨大的岩石上刻着文字。 -

scripts.text:
^3131FF- Those who advance may get hurt but are courageous of heart and those who move back will remain safe.
If you have courage, step forward. Otherwise, step backward. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF- 前进者或许会受伤，但心怀勇气；后退者则能安然无恙。
若你有勇气，就向前迈步。否则，就后退。 -^000000

scripts.text: Step forward.
scripts.translation: 向前迈步

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text: - You follow the way before you. -
scripts.translation: - 你沿着前方的道路前行。 -

scripts.text: - You won't advance. -
scripts.translation: - 你没有继续前进。 -

scripts.text: - There is writing on a big rock. -
scripts.translation: - 一块巨大的岩石上刻着文字。 -

scripts.text:
^3131FF- Those who advance may get hurt but are brave of heart and those who move back will remain safe.
If you are brave, then take a step forward. Otherwise, step back. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF- 前进者或许会受伤，但内心勇敢；后退者则能安然无恙。
若你勇敢，就向前迈步。否则，就后退。 -^000000

scripts.text: Step forward.
scripts.translation: 向前迈步

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text: - You follow the way before you. -
scripts.translation: - 你沿着前方的道路前行。 -

scripts.text: - You decide to stay. -
scripts.translation: - 你决定留下来。 -

scripts.translation: - 一块巨大的岩石上刻着文字。 -

scripts.text:
^3131FF- Those who advance may get hurt but are valorous of heart and those who move back will remain safe.
If you valorous, then take a step forward. Otherwise, step back. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF- 前进者或许会受伤，但英勇无畏；后退者则能安然无恙。

scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text: - You sense danger and decide to go back -
scripts.translation: - 你察觉到危险，决定后退。 -

scripts.text: - You decided to stay. -
scripts.translation: - 你决定留下来。 -

scripts.text:
^3131FF- Those who step forward will gain honor but may die, those who step backward will have courage but may still get hurt.
If you are truly brave, step forward. Otherwise, step back -^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF- 向前迈步者将赢得荣誉，但可能丧命；后退者虽有勇气，但仍可能受伤。
若你真正勇敢，就向前迈步。否则，就后退。 -^000000

scripts.text:
^3131FF- Those who stay may die but will gain honor, those who go back may get hurt but will gain courage.
Those who have courage will go back, otherwise step forward and stay. -^000000

scripts.text: - There is writing on a big rock. -
scripts.translation: - 一块巨大的岩石上刻着文字。 -

scripts.text: - If you want to protect your life, go back -
scripts.translation: - 如果你想保全性命，就后退吧 -

scripts.text: - You find a ship at anchor. -
scripts.translation: - 你发现了一艘停泊的船。 -

scripts.text: Take the ship and go back to the village.
scripts.translation: 乘船返回村庄

scripts.text: Explore more.
scripts.translation: 继续探索

scripts.text: - You board the ship and pull at the oars. -
scripts.translation: - 你登上船，划起了船桨。 -

scripts.text: - That unknown area arouses your interest. -
scripts.translation: - 那片未知的区域引起了你的兴趣。 -
